about_short_description.short_description: Retool is a software development company that offers solutions in AI apps, documentation, developer tools, and external apps.

product.name: Retool App Builder
product.description: A visual and AI-assisted development environment for creating production-ready internal applications connected to business data, APIs, and LLMs.

product.name: Retool Workflows
product.description: A workflow automation tool for orchestrating scheduled, event-driven, and data-processing tasks across databases, APIs, applications, and business systems.

product.name: Retool Agents
product.description: AI agents that use business data, tools, and workflows to perform operational tasks within governed Retool environments.

product.name: Retool External Apps
product.description: A platform for building applications and portals for customers, partners, vendors, and other users outside an organization.

product.name: Retool Mobile Apps
product.description: A mobile application development capability for building business and operational apps used by employees in the field or on mobile devices.

product.name: Retool Database
product.description: A managed database capability for storing and managing application data used by Retool apps, workflows, and operational processes.
